project.title: Customer Service Decision-Making Simulation
project.description:
I designed and developed this scenario-based learning experience in Articulate Storyline to simulate real-world customer service interactions.
The module guides learners through a multi-stage customer journey, where each decision affects the outcome and contributes to a final performance score. Feedback is tailored to reinforce key behaviours such as empathy, ownership, and clear communication.
This project demonstrates my ability to create interactive, decision-based learning experiences that go beyond static content and focus on behaviour change.
